title: Speaking — Collecting things
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on collecting things.

questions: What did you last use your phone for?
When do you prefer to put your phone away?
Which phone feature do you find especially useful?
Has your phone changed how you arrange to meet people?
Have you ever collected objects as a hobby?
What kinds of things do people you know keep?

part2.topic: Describe a collection that you found interesting.
part2.closing: and explain what you found out by looking at it.

questions: What does a collection reveal about the people who created it?
Should public collections give equal attention to everyday objects and rare items?
How has everyday life connected with collecting things changed for people of different ages?
